taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Web Push subscription ownership and delivery authorization
controls.source_trace: Determine who can attach, replace or delete a subscription and which user data the sender chooses independently of client-supplied recipient identifiers.
controls.implementation_branch: A PushSubscription includes an endpoint and encryption material, while a public application-server key has a different role. Verify which identity can update a stored subscription and which user payload is selected for delivery. Successful endpoint registration is not proof the provider accepted or delivered sensitive content.
controls.operational_method: Track endpoint/encryption material ownership across logout and account switch in the same browser profile. Record the authenticated server registration/update caller, previous owner, new owner and payload recipient selected by the sender. A subscription endpoint being accepted is not delivery proof. Use synthetic notifications and verify an old account marker is not sent to a subscription newly bound to another account unless explicitly permitted.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned subscriptions or a local push stub; compare rightful registration with another owned user/device binding and inspect a harmless delivered marker.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A subscription endpoint is not a login token; public VAPID keys or a successful registration status alone prove no message leakage.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind registration and delivery to authenticated ownership, preserving multi-device lifecycle and logout removal.
